top_signals.title: Korea Plans Market Meeting as Stock Swings Put Fund in Focus
top_signals.summary: South Korean authorities will meet financial industry leaders Monday to assess recent market conditions following the central bank’s rate hike, with the country’s stock market stabilization fund also likely to come up, according to the Financial Services Commission.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Treasuries Retreat as Gains in Equities Sap Demand for Havens
top_signals.summary: Treasuries fell in light trading as the market reopened after the Thanksgiving holiday, with gains in Asian equities damping demand for haven assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
